messages:
Jordan: Heads up — a customer hit a 403 on the Python quickstart when using a service account key. They followed the README exactly.
Priya: 403 on first call? what does the response body say?
Jordan: It was the HTML billing interstitial page (ugh). SDK prints: "PermissionError: 403" and then a few retries.
Theo (devex): HTML? That means the API returned an interactive billing page instead of a JSON error. Service accounts get redirected to the console billing flow if the workspace isn't fully activated.
Jordan: Repro steps from customer: 1) create workspace via SSO (auto-provisioned) 2) create service account via API 3) download key and run quickstart `python quickstart.py` -> 403.
QA-bot: Reproduced locally with a fresh org and SA key. Server responded with 403 + content-type: text/html, body contains "Activate your workspace" page.
Priya: Why is the backend returning HTML for API clients? We should always return structured JSON for programmatic failures.
Theo (devex): Root cause: billing interstitial is the old console flow. For browser flows we show HTML, for API we should return 402/403 JSON with {"code":"billing_inactive","message":"Activate workspace billing to enable API calls"}. Also the SDK retry logic treats 403 as transient in some cases and keeps retrying the same failing request, which spikes client-side latency.
BillingBot: Note: trial must be activated for service accounts created before billing activation. See /billing docs.
Nora (docs): We'll update the quickstart to warn about SA keys created before billing activation and add a preflight check snippet. Proposed snippet: `GET /v1/workspace` -> if status != active -> show helpful error.
Jordan: Customer found it confusing because console shows "workspace active" but billing contact missing. The backend state machine treats those as different flags.
Priya: Action items: 1) backend: ensure API endpoints never return HTML for programmatic requests; return structured billing_inactive error (prio high) (priya -> infra), 2) SDKs: treat billing_inactive/402/403 as non-retriable and surface an actionable error with link to console (theo -> devex-sdk), 3) quickstart: add preflight workspace/billing check and a clearer README note about SA timing (nora -> docs), 4) telemetry: add metric for first-call-403-by-new-org to quantify impact (qa -> infra).
Theo (devex): Quick mitigation for Python SDK: detect text/html responses and convert them into a BillingError with guidance instead of raw PermissionError. Also stop auto-retrying for 40x responses that include billing codes.
Jordan: I'll reply to the customer with the workaround: re-activate billing or create SA after activation, and we'll follow up when patch is out.
Nora (docs): I'll draft a tiny FAQ entry: "Why did my quickstart return 403 despite workspace showing active?" with repro and solution.
Priya: Let's prioritize the backend fix this sprint. This is a clear onboarding blocker for orgs created via SSO where billing step was deferred.
Jordan: Thanks — will drop a link to the PR here once it's up. :thumbsup:
